newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity falls in October - Bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity falls in October - Bank.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity slowed in October, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Friday.
The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity dropped to 175.9 from 176.4 a month earlier. It stood at 182.1 in August 1996.
In its previous bulletin issued earlier this month, the Bank said its coincident indicator for the month of September stood at 177.
The indicator, which takes January 1993 as 100, combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity.
The Bank created the indicator in 1993 because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon since the 1975-90 war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and economic growth.
